exercises.title: 6. Pratique: Diplomatic language and strategic ambiguity

items.prompt: One perspective that ___ consideration is that both parties acted in good faith.
There is, ___, some room to explore a shared frame.
I ___ whether it might be helpful to begin with individual conversations.
items.hintAfterError: Sujeito 'I' no presente simples: forma base.

items.prompt: Might it be worth ___ whether the real concern has not yet been named?
items.hintAfterError: Depois de 'be worth' o verbo vai para a forma -ing.

items.prompt: It could be argued that neither position is entirely without ___.
